text:
ashley: Quick heads-up — canary for cache eviction heuristics (LRU window tweak + prefetch skip) is live in us-west-2 at 5% traffic. owners: kernel=ryan, batching=marta, infra=samir. Need perf + correctness checks over next 90m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/runtime/canary/2287 :eyes:

ryan: Got it. I'll watch tail latency and P95 token latency. Where's the PR? pinging @marta for batching impact.

marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4922. Changes: skip-prefetch flag + batch-calc tweak. Running a local replay now. Early signal: ~3% lower median but small P95 blip under heavy tiny-req traffic.

samir: Infra note: adjusted node-group scale settings to keep capacity headroom for the canary. No network changes. Watching `evict_rate` and `kv_hits`. Logs show evict_rate trending down.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout step 1 -> 5% in us-west-2 (build 2026.03.17-4922). Monitors: evict_rate, p50/p95, kv_hits. No critical alerts.

ryan: I'm seeing one noisy host with rising P95 around 15:12 UTC; digging. @ashley any kernel redeploys to that pool recently?

ashley: Not from runtime side. Could be infra host flapping — @samir can you pull host id? host-7f2a on the dashboard.

samir: host-7f2a had a docker OOM at 15:11 UTC and restarted by kube. OOM dropped KV warmup causing P95 spike. I'm draining the host for remainder of canary. /cc @marta

marta: After removing that host, my replay p95 stabilizes. Still seeing slightly higher queueing for <32-token requests — batching threshold math looks off. Proposed fix in PR #4928 (max-batch-delay tweak).

ryan: Please open the patch. I can review in ~20m. Also let's add a histogram for prefetch misses per request (metric: prefetch_miss_count) so we can track regressions.

ashley: Created INF-2197 to add the metric. @marta please reference it in the PR.

marta: PR #4928 created and linked to INF-2197. Tests pass. Requesting review from @ryan and @ashley.

ryan: Reviewing now. Quick ask: include the perf-regression spec and add a short canary analysis note to the release doc (where we track rollout steps).

ashley: Will add the canary note. If ryan approves, plan: expand to 20% in 2h, then 50% after 6h if stable. Owners pinned — kernel (ryan) for canary changes, batching (marta) for batch params, infra (samir) for node availability. Post-mortem if error rate >0.1%.

tony: FYI support logged 2 user reports of slight latency in us-west-2 between 15:10–15:22; resolved after host drain. Filing INC-8342.

ashley: Thanks @tony. Next sync at the regular #eng-runtime standup at 16:30. If anyone sees new regressions, ping here. :thumbsup:
